note: Project x_frame_options; the enabled module machine name is x_frame_options_configuration. All state is the config object x_frame_options_configuration.settings with NESTED keys x_frame_options_configuration.directive (DENY|SAMEORIGIN|ALLOW-FROM|ALLOW-ALL) and x_frame_options_configuration.allow-from-uri. There is no config schema or default config, so at baseline the object is absent; cleanup deletes it to restore baseline. Medium cases write a known directive/uri and the agent reads it via drush cget; hard cases set a baseline directive and the agent must change it, verified against the live config object. XframeSubscriber (RESPONSE priority -20) applies the header; ALLOW-ALL removes it.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the x_frame_options (X-frame-options Configuration) module, which config object stores its settings and what directive values can the X-Frame-Options header be set to?
evals.expected_output: Settings live in x_frame_options_configuration.settings (nested key x_frame_options_configuration.directive). The directive can be DENY, SAMEORIGIN, ALLOW-FROM (with an allow-from-uri), or ALLOW-ALL.

evals.prompt: In the x_frame_options module, what does choosing the 'ALLOW-ALL' directive do to the X-Frame-Options response header?
evals.expected_output: ALLOW-ALL makes the response subscriber REMOVE the X-Frame-Options header entirely (so the page can be framed by anyone).

evals.prompt: How does the x_frame_options module add the X-Frame-Options header to responses on a Drupal site, and what is the actual enabled module machine name?
evals.expected_output: The enabled module machine name is x_frame_options_configuration. It registers a kernel RESPONSE event subscriber (XframeSubscriber, priority -20) that sets X-Frame-Options on every response based on the configured directive.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the X-Frame-Options directive has been configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which directive is currently set.
evals.expected_output: x_frame_options_configuration.settings has x_frame_options_configuration.directive = SAMEORIGIN (read with: drush cget x_frame_options_configuration.settings).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the X-Frame-Options directive is set to ALLOW-FROM. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which URI is allowed to frame the site.

On this Drupal site, configure the x_frame_options module so that every page sends the header 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' (the site must never be embeddable in a frame). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set x_frame_options_configuration.settings key x_frame_options_configuration.directive to 'DENY' (via the settings form or configFactory getEditable set save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the x_frame_options module is currently set to DENY all framing, but the team now needs same-origin pages to be embeddable. Change the X-Frame-Options directive to SAMEORIGIN. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Change x_frame_options_configuration.settings key x_frame_options_configuration.directive from DENY to 'SAMEORIGIN'.
